tags.name: Core API · Leads Caps
tags.description:
Advertiser Lead Caps
> [!Information] The following endpoints are for managing Leads Caps at the Advertiser level.

tags.name: Core API · Revenue Caps
tags.description:
Advertiser Revenue Caps

tags.name: Core API · Contract Affiliate Caps
tags.description:
Lead Contract Affiliate Caps 
> [!Information] These are Campaign Specific Caps that are set at the Contract Level. Please note that these Caps do not restrict the Campaign, but rather restrict how much this Contract can receive from a specific Campaign.

tags.name: Core API · Attached Contracts
tags.description:
Offer Attached Contracts
> [!Information] These endpoints allow you to retrieve a list of Contracts that are currently attached to the specified Offer.
